document: Trial CT-12371 is a Phase 2 study of parsatide versus placebo-matched standard care, sponsored by Corvid Analytics. The planned enrolment target was 300 patients; 293 patients were ultimately enrolled. The primary endpoint is HbA1c reduction; secondary endpoints include quality of life.

schema.drug_name: string: the investigational drug (not the comparator)
schema.enrolled_patients: integer: patients actually enrolled (not the planned target)
